about:
RDM Industrial Electronics is headquartered in Nebo, North Carolina, and operates branches in Colorado, Florida, Indiana, Texas, Pennsylvania, and Georgia. The company’s founding year and original founders are not disclosed in public materials, and no specific ownership designation (such as family-, veteran-, or woman-owned) is indicated.

The company supplies new and remanufactured petroleum electronic equipment, specializing in circuit boards, intercom systems for convenience stores, fuel dispenser security devices, displays, printers, card readers, motors, keypads and overlays, point-of-sale systems, consoles, tank monitors, and probes. All branches maintain fully stocked, ready-to-ship inventory. RDM employs degreed technicians and engineers and provides free technical support and training. Its operations are organized into five divisions: Petroleum, Car Wash, Intercom, Industrial, and Medical.

RDM serves the petroleum retail, car wash, convenience store, industrial, and medical sectors. Concrete examples include fuel dispenser security for gas stations, intercoms for convenience store operations, and tank monitoring equipment for petroleum storage. The company’s divisional structure reflects these verticals, with dedicated catalogs for Petroleum, Car Wash, Intercom, Industrial, and Medical customers.

RDM states its mission is to deliver five-star quality products and customer service with the quickest delivery in the industry. Differentiators cited include an all-degreed technical staff, complimentary technical support and training, and a multi-location inventory network designed for rapid order fulfillment.
